groups.name: Visuals
items: All 14 Infernal units now use layered six-direction artwork and matching combat effects.
Dragon, Phoenix, Hellhound and Imps use creature rigs with separately moving wings, tails and legs. Imp squads retain their three-member formation.
Eye of Ruin has a separate eye, casing and animated wings; casters and bosses have moving equipment and spell effects.
Effects follow real fire damage, Hellgate summons, Immolation, Phoenix rebirth, Wall of Flame, pulling hooks and Devil's Bargain.
Full-faction test links appear as each roster becomes complete. The workshop reports each rig's actual piece count.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Effect impacts follow targets after Hellbinder pulls them. Burn effects appear only when damage is applied.
Creature effects respect fog, pause and zoom; source art remains separate from gameplay rules.
